messages:
ryan: Quick check — can we borrow 8 H100 slots in eu-west1 for a ~6h loadtest tomorrow 09:00 UTC? Our dedicated pool is saturated and this run needs low latency for realtime evals. @alex @maria
alex: Which pool are you spilling from (demo vs infra)? and what's the cost center? I can look at quotas now.
maria: @ryan what's the exact SKU/instance? h100-4g, h100-8g, etc? region confirmed eu-west1?
ryan: h100-4g (vendor SKU H100-48G). Need 8 GPUs spread across 2 nodes. Region = eu-west1. Cost center = ML-Labs.
sam: FYI vendor spot windows have been flaky — last time we got evicted mid-test. If this is for a scheduled 09:00 run, we should either reserve or plan fallback.
procurement-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4823 to request an 8-slot short-term allocation from VendorX for ML-Labs (6h). Vendor ops ETA historically ~4-6h.
alex: Checking cloud quota quickly — running `gcloud compute regions describe eu-west1 --project=redwood-infra` to see family availability, will paste output.
alex: quick snippet: ```
GPU_FAMILY h100:
  total: 16
  used: 12
  available: 4
```
alex: So native quota only has 4 available, we need vendor-backed capacity for the other 4.
vendor-ops: We can push 8 spot-backed H100s into eu-west1. Caveats: (1) ~2h provisioning/warm-up, (2) spot-backed means possible evictions, (3) we can convert to a short reserved burst (6h) at +15% on the invoice. Need finance ok for the burst.
ryan: I approve +15% for 6h for this run. Tag ML-Labs on the invoice. Proceed.
maria: I'll add graceful degradation to the loadtest to handle node eviction and a KV-cache warmup step so results aren't noisy.
sam: @vendor-ops can you confirm the image/AMI and node labels you'll attach? we need `redwood-infer-v2` image and label `pool=burst-h100`.
vendor-ops: Confirmed image: `redwood-infer-v2:2026-03-15`. Nodes will be labelled `pool=burst-h100`. ETA to attach capacity: ~3h. INFRA-4823 updated with allocation IDs and estimated attach time.
ryan: Perfect — I'll move the loadtest to 12:00 UTC to give a buffer and update the run doc. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
alex: I'll update the quota dashboard and add a short note about fallback to A100 in the runbook.
procurement-bot: INFRA-4823 -> vendor confirmed, finance notified. Closing loop when billing tag is attached.
ryan: Great, closing this thread for now — will post results after the test.
